svg.text: Presentation Tier (React 18 SPA), Application Execution Tier (Node.js/Express), and Cloud Persistence Tier (MongoDB Atlas)

g.text: TIER 1: PRESENTATION & CLIENT USER EXPERIENCE TIER (REACT 18 SINGLE PAGE APPLICATION)
1. HTTPS REST Endpoints (Port 443) — Bearer JWT & JSON
2. WSS Full-Duplex WebSockets (Port 443) — Real-Time Match Events
TIER 2: APPLICATION, BUSINESS LOGIC & SANDBOX EXECUTION TIER (NODE.JS & EXPRESS SERVER)
• Passwords Hashed via Bcrypt (10 Salt Rounds)
• Unique UUID JTI Nonce Embedded in Payloads
• Sub-Millisecond Token Blacklist Query on Requests
• Immediate Session Kill upon Password Change/Logout
• Student: Execution, Duels, Profile, Daily Solves
• Live Testcase Pass Ratio Streaming (e.g. 8/10 Tests)
• Sudden Death / Draw Evaluation on Timer Expiry
• Draw: +25 ELO Points to Both Contestants
• Abstract Syntax Tree Lexical Regex Scanner
• Blocks fs, child_process, eval, Function, import
• Isolated Node.js vm2 Context with Prototype Null
• Evaluates Public & Secret Hidden Test Suites
3. Mongoose 8 ODM Driver (TCP 27017) — B-Tree Indexes & Atomic Write Ops
TIER 3: PERSISTENCE & CLOUD STORAGE TIER (MONGODB ATLAS DISTRIBUTED REPLICA SET)
Presentation Tier: Client React 18 SPA on Vercel CDN
Application Tier: Node.js/Express Container on Render
Persistence Tier: MongoDB Atlas Multi-AZ Sharded Replica Cluster
Security: TTL Index Session Blacklisting & In-Memory AST Sandbox
System Guarantees: Sub-200ms API response latency, sub-50ms WebSocket duel state updates, strict zero cross-user code leakage.
